question: Related Questions Q. I am elder son me and my father start doing business by investing equal amount of money,after one year second son also start helping in the business. After seven year father me want to seprat our business due to some dispute. Now pls guide us according shariah how shell we divide our money and property (either purchased or cunstructed) in these years? 1568 views Q. Is commercial broking halal or haram? For example: A person helps another person buy a shop worth 1 lakh in return expects 2000 rupees or 2% of the total 1263 views Q. i am a goverment servent having limited source of income i hardly manage to save some amount of money for the welfare of my children as the inflation goes up what is the islamic way to invest my money so that i can get at the end of retirement handsome amount for the welfare of the family. 1816 views Q. Assalamu alaikum I hv a brother. We both are married and having sons. We were living with our uncles after my father's death (my mother's brother) and working under them for the past 15 to 20yrs. Due to misunderstanding our uncles gave our part of inheritance, we were forced to leave ours uncles company. We started our own business but unfortunately it's not doing well. In the mean time we don't have own house and we are still leaving in our uncles flat. We are not comfortable leaving there after coming out. If we want to buy a flat we don't have money to purchase, in the above context please advise whether we can get loan from bank to buy a house or flat. Based on your fatwa we wl do accordingly. 1692 views Q. Assalamualikum.One of my friend took my new sherwani which was worn by me just one time in my nikah it cost about Rs.10,000/-to wear in his nikah ceremony.He has lost it.I asked atleast for the money in return but he refuse to give whereas they are rich.What does Shariah says about this.Please reply. 1773 views Q. Salaamolaikum, I reside in a rented house and end up paying significant money as rent, I do not have an own house. It is difficult to save enough money and then buy a house by paying the whole amount at one go. My other assets are also not enough to buy a house even if I sell all of them. In this context am I allowed to avail a loan from a bank and buy or construct a house and then pay back the money in instalments, knowing that the bank is going to add interest to the principle when getting back the loan? Also this loan will help me in getting significant rebate on my taxable money(income tax). 1727 views Q. We are five partners and four of us are investing money for a business and one will monitor and maintain liason and work physically too. The profit will be equally distributed among us. Our business is mainly with small vehicles and we will give them to a garrege owner who will arrange drivers and security of the vehicles from stealing. The garrege owner will pay us a certain rent for every vehicle everyday and he will also take a certain amount from every vehicle everyday from the drivers. We the investors will manage money to repair the vehicles when necessary. My question, is our income halal in this condition? 1503 views Q. Provident Fund 4113 views Q. Assalamlikum I had a plot of 262 sq.ft., my elder brother told me sell this plot and buy another place (due to some litigation) & sold around Rs.4,97,800/- for this intention to buy another plot in a prime location, more than 6 years back. After selling my elder brother asked for hand loan & I gave hand loan (kharzi hasana) to him Rs.270000/- for 3 month commitment only. Till today I did not get back the money. Even I used hard words after the maturity. He has the money but he is not giving, investing in real estate and earning money with my money. & I am waiting when he will return back my money I will by the plot. Now the land prices are so high & increased 13 to 15 times more in this 6 years timne. Even which I sold the above plot price 15 times increased. Due to block this hand loan money I did not invest the amount in plot. If I invested above sold plot amount in another plot present value will be around Rs.75 to 80 lakhs will get. For this I have lost lakhs of rupees. So requesting to provide me a fatwa above my lakhs of rupees loses. Now how much I have to collect with him? Actual amount or actual amount plus loses. 1768 views Q. Giving out any residential place or any shop on rent is the reflection of the business of interest in its concept. Is it right or wrong? please elaborate with reference to Quran and Hadith. 2202 views Q. My brother has taken a jungle resort for lease. the agreement is that he has pay some amount at the end of each year which shall be mutually decided. there is no deposit amount. Is it fine? Also in that resort some guests come and drink alcohol etc. though my brother does not supply.But they get it along with them. Is this permissible? Is running of resorts allowed in Islam? 1799 views Q. Is the lottery system jayaz (allowed /reasonable) in islam..For example, a person says to a group of 10 people that you submit 500 rupees pe rmonth to me and at the end of every month , he will raise a bid (I mean boli lgayega), and the person who speaks the lowest bid /rate then he can collect the total amont of lottery? 3962 views Q. Exchange of Mobile 2036 views Q. I have huge loans from the bank and have a lot of difficulty of paying the same. I am praying to allah to resolve me of my difficulties of finishing up the loans to the bank. I have a building in which there are 2 floors vacant and i have refused to let out the building to the banks because thier income is from interest. I would like to know "can I give the building to the bank and take the income and finish of the loans which are prevailing " is it allowed in islam. Please let me know at your earliest. 1659 views Q. In my business I have to buy materials from suppliers . They take a 3-5% commission for there help in getting the materials to me. As they are using their contacts and goodwill to procure materials for me. In fact they are taking this amount from the raw material manufacturer as the amount is added into my price. Can I buy the materials from the suppliers without doing a GUNAAH in the light of the SHARIAT ? WILL MY EARNED MONEY BE HALAL ! If it is GUNAAH in the light of SHARIAH then I will have to buy the material direct from the manufacturer , but will it not amount to BREACH OF TRUST ON MY PART BECAUSE THESE SUPPLIERS HAVE HELPED ME ESTABLISH MY BUSINESS and Now when I leave them ( because I can now finance my business without their help ) will it not be wrong on my PART IN THE LIGHT OF THE SHARIAT ? Jazak ALLAH O KHAIR for helping me. 1646 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 26607 Country: Bangladesh Title: We are five partners and four of us are investing money for a business and one will monitor and maintain liason and work physically too. The profit will be equally distributed among us. Our business is mainly with small vehicles and we will give them to a garrege owner who will arrange drivers and security of the vehicles from stealing. The garrege owner will pay us a certain rent for every vehicle everyday and he will also take a certain amount from every vehicle everyday from the drivers. We the investors will manage money to repair the vehicles when necessary. My question, is our income halal in this condition? Question: As salamu alaikum. We are five partners and four of us are investing money for a business and one will monitor and maintain liason and work physically too. The profit will be equally distributed among us. Our business is mainly with small vehicles and we will give them to a garrege owner who will arrange drivers and security of the vehicles from stealing. The garrege owner will pay us a certain rent for every vehicle everyday and he will also take a certain amount from every vehicle everyday from the drivers. We the investors will manage money to repair the vehicles when necessary. My question, is our income halal in this condition? Answer ID: 26607 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2550/1582/H=1431) It is right for the four partners, who have invested, to divide the profit equally. However, the fifth person whose responsibility is to monitor, his salary should be fixed instead of making him partner in profit, then this dealing shall become right. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
